messages:
acme_ops: Hey team — we deactivated our org last night but noticed credits still got consumed and there are token charges on the invoice. Can someone check?

maria_support: Sorry to hear that — can you DM the org id and the invoice number? we'll take a look. :eyes:

acme_ops: Sent via DM: org_4521, invoice #INV-2026-03-16. Screenshot: https://img.example.com/clip1.png We deactivated at ~2026-03-16T22:10Z. Charges show at 22:12 and 22:15.

sam_billing: Pulling ledger for org_4521 now. initial glance: there are three consumption rows at 2026-03-16T22:12, 22:14, 22:15 with token burns and then a credit-application entry at 22:16. That's odd — credits should be applied before any external invoicing.

billing-bot: LEDGER_SNIPPET:
```
org_id: org_4521
2026-03-16T22:12:03Z usage tokens: 1,230 source: api key sk-live-XXXX
2026-03-16T22:14:20Z usage tokens: 2,540 source: api key sk-live-XXXX
2026-03-16T22:15:44Z usage tokens: 980 source: api key sk-live-XXXX
2026-03-16T22:16:01Z credit_debit: -10000 free_credit_allocation id: fc_77
```

jon_eng: Thanks — can you share exact repro steps or a request sample? we need to know if requests were queued or retried after deactivation.

acme_ops: The sequence was: (1) cancel via org settings UI -> click Deactivate (2) we have a scheduled job that runs every 10m which posts to your /v1/chat/completions using the org API key. It seems that job executed once immediately after we hit Deactivate. Sample request (redacted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run nightly sync"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
```

maria_support: That fits a race: deactivation completed in the control plane but the API key might not have been revoked instantly.

sam_billing: The issue I'm seeing: credits are applied at a later reconciliation step which currently runs asynchronously. Because usage rows were created first, they show up as consumption and then the credit entry is post-facto, which looks like charges happening after deactivation. The user is billed in interim.

jon_eng: Jumping in — probable root cause: deactivation flow sets org.active=false, but key revocation is handled by the key-rotation worker which can be delayed (up to ~60s). Meanwhile, the router will accept in-flight requests and record usage. Our billing pipeline currently reclassifies credits in a later batch job and doesn't backfill invoice micro-lines atomically.

lina_accounts: For resolution we should do two things: (1) issue a provisional credit/refund for the affected token amount so acme sees no charge on the invoice, (2) fix the pipeline to ensure credit application and deactivation are ordered deterministically. I'll create a ledger adjustment then escalate for a hotfix.

maria_support: Acme — we'll credit the token amount now as a one-off and update the invoice. Can you confirm you want us to reverse the 3 usage rows?

acme_ops: Yes please — reverse them. We expected no usage after deactivation. Thanks.

sam_billing: Done (provisional): ledger adjustment +10,000 tokens applied to org_4521. Updated invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-03-16 (now shows zero net charge). I'll file a follow-up to make this permanent after the engineering fix.

jon_eng: Action items for eng: (A) change deactivation path to revoke API keys synchronously before returning success (B) make billing reconciliation apply credits in the same atomic transaction or mark usage as 'post-deactivation' and auto-refund, (C) add alert when credits are applied with a timestamp later than usage by >30s for deactivated orgs. I'll open ENG-4367 and assign.

maria_support: Created support ticket SUP-9876 with the refund details and ENG-4367 linked. We'll notify when the hotfix is deployed. :white_check_mark:

acme_ops: Appreciate the quick turnaround. One ask: can we get a short postmortem once the fix is live? We want to ensure scheduled jobs won't cause this again.

jon_eng: Absolutely — we'll include the timeline, root cause, and a permanent mitigation ETA (hotfix + prod deploy within 48 hours).

maria_support: Closing the loop here: refund applied, invoice updated, eng ticket created. Reopen if anything else shows up. :handshake:
